user.title: Area entities
user.description: One thermostat per area: pick the room's temperature sensor and the real climate devices it arbitrates.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor that represents the room temperature; the thermostat regulates against this, not the devices' internal sensors.
data_description.cool_entity: Climate entity providing cooling — and heat boost/fallback if it can heat.
data_description.heat_entity: Climate entity providing primary heat (e.g. underfloor heating). Leave empty for cooling-only areas.

heat_strategy.title: Primary heating commands
heat_strategy.description: How the primary heat source is told to heat or stand down.

data_description.heat_strategy: Preset: drive preset modes (Heatmiser Neo home/standby). HVAC mode: drive heat/off directly.
data_description.heat_active_preset: Only used with the preset strategy.
data_description.heat_idle_preset: Only used with the preset strategy.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure area
reconfigure.description: Swap the entities this area thermostat arbitrates.

error.same_entity: The heating and cooling entities must be different.

abort.already_configured: An area thermostat for this sensor and air conditioner already exists.

data_description.act_delta: In heat or cool mode, engage when the temperature is this far beyond the target. In heat/cool (auto) mode the low/high range itself is the dead band.
data_description.idle_delta: Optional: release a heating/cooling call once the temperature is back within this distance of the threshold. Leave empty for automatic release — at the midpoint of the low/high range in heat/cool (auto) mode, 0.5 °C from the target in single-target modes. An explicit value is capped at half the low/high gap in heat/cool mode.
data_description.boost_delta: Bring the air conditioning in as boost heat when the temperature is this far below the heat threshold; the boost then runs until the call releases.
data_description.keep_alive: Forced re-assert of modes, presets, and setpoints on every interval — undoes manual fiddling at the device.
data_description.sensor_stale_timeout: If the temperature sensor stays unavailable this long, all sources are idled for safety.

error.idle_not_below_act: The release hysteresis (0.5 °C when left empty) must be smaller than the act threshold.
error.min_not_below_max: The minimum setpoint must be at least 1 °C below the maximum.
